0022600170.text: The Warriors, at home for their 8th game of the season, are 3-3 overall, 1-1 at home, and 3-3 over their last ten, currently on a three-game winning streak, while the Phoenix Suns are 1-3 and on a two-game losing streak. Golden State is 10th in the West and 2nd in the Pacific, 1 game back, and Phoenix is 12th in the West and 3rd in the Pacific, 2 games back. Golden State will be without Stephen Curry, Draymond Green, Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis and Moses Moody, and Phoenix will be without Mark Williams; the Warriors trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 131-122 in Phoenix on October 24, though they won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
